summary: Iteration 2 frontend regression for the SignuluOne static site. Tested all 12 pages for theme consistency (violet #5A30F1 primary, Lato, no navy/blue remnants, no Log in), the trial-modal product gate (3 redirects), pricing tabs with 3 distinct plan sets per product, /products.html -> /solutions.html stub redirect, contact page product prefill via ?product= and ?intent=trial, form validation + success alert, solutions page sections/anchors, external product links, responsive at 375/768/1440, and the mobile hamburger + modal usability. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: include.js occasionally logs a transient 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' when the browser aborts the initial partial fetch during rapid navigation. Non-blocking (cache retry on next call works) but consider swallowing/re-trying once in load() to keep the console clean.
products.html uses meta-refresh + location.replace which is fine, but adding a 301 redirect at the hosting layer would be cleaner for SEO.
Contact form is client-side only (spec says mocked). No CSRF/rate-limit concerns today, but note when a backend is added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site is served by python -m http.server on port 3000 (see /app/frontend/package.json). No React/CRA, no backend. Base URL = REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key data-testids verified: nav-free-trial-btn, hero-trial-btn, solutions-trial-btn, pricing-hero-trial-btn, footer-trial-link, product-modal-trial-btn, trial-product-select, trial-continue-btn, trial-error-message, nav-solutions-link, mega-*-link, pricing-tab-*, pricing-pane-*, solutions-esignature/dms/bulksigner, contact-product-select, contact-success-alert. Note urllib-based link scans hit 403 because http.server rejects the default UA; use curl or a real browser for HTTP status checks.
